method: Offline native Linux EEVEE software rendering. Not live game screenshots, GPU/FPS evidence, source shader acceptance or final art approval.
lighting: Citadel source ember / gauntlet source void directional color, direction and intensity; ambient converted to uniform world approximation, not actual hemisphere or PMREM.
limitations: Source procedural hull maps are an average RGB proxy; original world-projected UVs are exercised only by the actual Batch CPU tests.
EEVEE AgX +0.6 is not Three ACES exposure1.02. Fog, PMREM, rim shader, post-FX/bloom and live occlusion are not reproduced.
World deck/channel/seams/lane boundary are labeled geometry test doubles; only player uses actual shipped GLB at unscaled dimensions.

Fixed common WORLD-space placement with source CameraRig pose, FOV and orthographic extent. Offline clipping .1/1000 differs from source high-quality .35/1344; no object-fitted cameras or full projection-matrix identity claim.
Cue extrema use exact source hues and analytic BREATHE gains .1 and1 with gain1.1; offline emission response is approximate.
